context: Asuka lectures on the Earth and space.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: science lecture; cosmology vocabulary (宇宙/地球/得る/含め/同様) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地球は、広い宇宙の一部です。
lines.en: Earth is a part of the vast universe.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 宇宙には、地球以外の星もありますか?
lines.en: Are there stars besides Earth in space?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 無数の星を含めて、宇宙は広がっています。
lines.en: Including countless stars, the universe expands.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 地球と同様の星は、あるんですか?
lines.en: Are there stars similar to Earth?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地球と同様の環境は、稀だと考えられます。
lines.en: Earth-like environments are thought to be rare.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 宇宙のことは、どうやって知るんですか?
lines.en: How do we learn about space?
lines.style: thoughtful teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 観測から、多くの情報を得ます。
lines.en: We gain much information from observation.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 宇宙を含めて、自然は不思議ですね。
lines.style: moved teen boy voice, soft warm wonder delivery throughout
